# Boards: what Jumper emulates

Every board, every peripheral, and how we know. Statuses:

- **✅ verified**: a committed fixture test ran real firmware on this board (or its chip) and checked it (linked).
- **🟡 partial**: works with a stated gap, or real firmware ran but not as a committed passing test.
- **⚪ untested**: the code exists in the emulator and Jumper's backend, but no real firmware has exercised it yet. Treat it as not emulated until it is verified.
- **❌ no**: not emulated. The firmware cannot use it in Jumper; test it on the real board.
- **n/a**: the chip has no such peripheral.

A board is placeable in the parts library only when its fixture test proves it boots real firmware and its listed buses work (part.json `availability`); the others are listed as planned with the reason.

### Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3
<a id="seeed-xiao-esp32s3"></a>

Part `seeed-xiao-esp32s3`, backend `qemu-esp`: Espressif QEMU on this computer (Docker image jumper/qemu-esp), started by jumper serve. **Available**: Its fixture test passed on 2026-11-11 (packages/sim-backends/src/qemu-esp/boards.integration.test.ts, board seeed-xiao-esp32s3): real arduino-esp32 3.3.12 firmware built by Jumper's own pipeline boots in Espressif's QEMU; GPIO output, GPIO input with the internal pull-up, and Serial (UART0) reach Jumper's parts. Proven on image jumper/qemu-esp:9.2.2-20260417-jb3; the merged image jb5 (adds PWM, ADC, SPI, RMT, interrupts, UART1/2, I2C on every chip) has not been built or re-run yet. Other peripherals: see the board's fidelity.json.

| Area | Status | Notes | Test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Boots real firmware | ✅ verified | proven on image jb3 (esp-app); not re-run on the merged jb5 image | [boards.integration.test.ts](../packages/sim-backends/src/qemu-esp/boards.integration.test.ts) |
| GPIO (+ pulls) | ✅ verified | output, input with the internal pull-up; proven on jb3 | [boards.integration.test.ts](../packages/sim-backends/src/qemu-esp/boards.integration.test.ts) |
| PWM | ⚪ untested | LEDC: bridged in the jb5 QEMU image and Jumper's backend (fake-QEMU protocol tests pass), but the image was never built and no real firmware has exercised it |  |
| ADC | ⚪ untested | single-shot ADC fed by the solved pad voltage: bridged in the jb5 QEMU image and Jumper's backend (fake-QEMU protocol tests pass), but the image was never built and no real firmware has exercised it |  |
| Pin interrupts | ⚪ untested | GPIO interrupts (edge and level): bridged in the jb5 QEMU image and Jumper's backend (fake-QEMU protocol tests pass), but the image was never built and no real firmware has exercised it |  |
| UART | 🟡 partial | UART0 (Serial) verified on jb3; UART1 / UART2 bridged in the jb5 QEMU image and Jumper's backend (fake-QEMU protocol tests pass), but the image was never built and no real firmware has exercised it | [boards.integration.test.ts](../packages/sim-backends/src/qemu-esp/boards.integration.test.ts) |
| I2C | ⚪ untested | QEMU had no I2C controller for the ESP32-S3; jb5 adds one: bridged in the jb5 QEMU image and Jumper's backend (fake-QEMU protocol tests pass), but the image was never built and no real firmware has exercised it |  |
| SPI | ⚪ untested | SPI2 / SPI3 master: bridged in the jb5 QEMU image and Jumper's backend (fake-QEMU protocol tests pass), but the image was never built and no real firmware has exercised it |  |
| I2S | ❌ no | Jumper's I2S bus and the MAX98357A / INMP441 parts exist, but QEMU has no I2S + DMA device yet |  |
| NeoPixel / WS2812 | ⚪ untested | RMT transmit (NeoPixel): bridged in the jb5 QEMU image and Jumper's backend (fake-QEMU protocol tests pass), but the image was never built and no real firmware has exercised it |  |
| Wi-Fi / network | ⚪ untested | the netstack and the r3 Wi-Fi shim are chip-independent, but no firmware for this chip has run through them; the radio itself is not emulated |  |
| BLE | ❌ no | QEMU has no radio model |  |
| Languages | | arduino: ✅ verified (simulation build jumper/arduino-esp32:3.3.12-r3; device build JUMPER_SIM=0); micropython: ❌ no (the official S3 build stops at 'Failed to set QIE bit' (REPL on USB-OTG); needs a UART-REPL build); esp-idf: ⚪ untested (image jumper/esp-idf:5.5.5-r1 built; no project build ran (Docker failed)) | |

## Gaps across boards

- **Wi-Fi radio and BLE are not emulated anywhere.** ESP32 Wi-Fi sketches run unchanged through an emulated Ethernet card and Jumper's sandbox network (docs/network.md); signal, range and roaming are not modelled.
- **The merged ESP32 emulator image (jumper/qemu-esp:9.2.2-20260417-jb5) has not been built**: Docker Desktop on the integration machine was hung. Until it is built and the fixture tests re-run, ESP32 boards fail to start with "image missing" and a fix (`pnpm jumper setup esp32`).
- **Process-backend boards (QEMU, Renode) run only through `jumper serve`** (the page follows that run); the page itself runs AVR and RP2040 boards.
- **Renode starts on the first step and blocks the server thread for about 2.4 s** at start and on reset.
